links.outcome: Agreement of CI stage classification versus two other language models on same data
links.effect: GPT-4o framework weighted Cohen's kappa 0.95 and Spearman 0.93, versus weighted kappa 0.82-0.85 for two other language models
links.quote: Evaluated on 165,926 notes from 1002 Medicare patients from Mass General Brigham (MGB), our GPT-4o framework achieved high accuracy in CI stage classification (weighted Cohen's kappa = 0.95, Spearman correlation = 0.93), and outperformed two other language models (weighted Cohen's kappa 0.82-0.85).

unlisted_practices: Confidence-aware decision-making and multi-step reasoning in an LLM framework for classifying cognitive impairment from clinical notes

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates a GPT-4o framework and agent with clinician oversight for cognitive impairment staging from EHR notes, focusing on framework accuracy and design rather than testing a specific deployment guardrail practice.
